The gorgeous decorations and festive colors seem to convey sweetness and excitement every moment. In such a strong atmosphere, you can experience an unusual emotional journey with Chen Xi.
[h3]🏮Combination of tradition and romance[/h3]
Is it pasting Spring Festival couplets, receiving red envelopes, and the family sitting together to make dumplings?
In "Yume 5", we combine these traditional customs with the game plot, so that you can not only feel the Chinese romance, but also experience the strong festive atmosphere.
Lunar New Year and Sese🤔🤔🤔

Chen Xi's delicate body lies on the bed, and her appearance in the camera is beautiful and charming. There was a hint of mystery and temptation in her eyes...
